title: Same words, two readings: late orders "delivered in 2017"
subtitle: One Dot answer inside a follow-up chain, one in a fresh chat. Both match the raw data under the date each used.
alt: Bar chart of two Dot answers to how many orders delivered in 2017 were late, on the Olist dataset. Inside a follow-up chain, Dot used purchase date and returned 2,453. In a fresh chat, it used delivery date and returned 1,762.
caption: Late orders for "delivered in 2017", asked inside a follow-up chain and in a fresh chat. Olist dataset, Dot, 31 October 2026. The run's mode is not stated.
